node: Student-loan servicing, education payments, and compliance infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the student-loan servicing, education-payments, and compliance-infrastructure node. The underfollowed lane is more useful than the obvious education-content lane because the node sits inside specialty finance, payment enablement, loan operations, bank funding, regulatory compliance, and university back-office workflows. Four US-listed candidates were selected: Nelnet as the closest reference/underfollowed hybrid for servicing systems and education payments; Flywire as an education payment rail and tuition-cross-border processor; SLM as a private-education-loan originator/servicer with direct student-finance exposure; and Navient as a speculative-shadow legacy servicer/portfolio run-off name where regulatory and business-model transition risks must be heavily verified.
